blocks.text: 1. Paris's three asks: offline sync, a signed PDF per inspection, export by site
3. Decide field versioning: who owns what, how changes are agreed
Proposal: Capulet owns the inspection record, Montague owns the envelope, both approve any change.
Ask: how do we tell which version an event is on?
Walked Romeo through the three asks.
Offline sync is the queue. The PDF is Balcony. Export by site: not this week.
Told him what I told Paris: Ducal sees only what Ducal sends.
Prototype survived an hour offline. Nothing lost.
Events arrive with the time they were signed, not the time they synced. Auditors care.
